column1: # Semantic function renames (Phase C). Applied to source by tools/apply_names.py and
# consumed at BUILD time by tools/ccproc.py, which keeps the original
# .text.func_<addr> section name (so the SORT_BY_NAME link order is unchanged) and
# emits a `func_<addr> = <new_name>` symbol alias (so any un-renamed asm/C caller
# still resolves). Both are stripped by objcopy => the byte-exact binary is unaffected.
#   old_name : original symbol, must equal func_<ADDR>
#   new_name : readable camelCase C identifier (never starts with func_)
#   evidence : non-empty justification (config/knowledge/*.json, adrando anchor, idiom)
# Names are conservative: they describe the verified mechanical operation, not guessed
# gameplay semantics. Confidence noted in evidence where medium.
